narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Management says revenue growth will be higher in FY27 than FY26.
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: FY26 revenue grew 10.5% YoY to 6455 cr, slower than FY25's 21% growth, indicating deceleration.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Management expects EBITDA margin of 22‑24% in FY27.
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: FY26 EBITDA margin fell to 18.9% from 21.1% in FY25, showing margin pressure.

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Management plans to invest >5% of revenue in tech/AI in FY27.
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: FY26 investing cash flow was -1188 cr (~18% of revenue) and fixed assets grew 2010 cr (~31% of revenue), indicating capex already >5%.

guidance_now: Overall revenue growth to be stronger in H2 versus H1 FY27.
Positive top-line growth expected in Q4 FY27.
Sustained double-digit growth in commercial vehicle/off‑highway segment for years to come.
AI‑based revenue share to increase materially from the current 9% level.
Management will disclose internal KPIs and product‑revenue breakdown by Q4 FY27.
European OEM vendor‑consolidation wave largely complete by end of Q1 FY28.
Broad‑based growth strategy will more than offset revenue impact from European OEM budget cuts.
bull: Revenue grew YoY in every quarter of FY26, showing resilience despite margin pressure.
Investing cash flow jumped to -1188 cr in FY26, reflecting strong reinvestment.
Fixed assets rose by 2010 cr in FY26, supporting growth initiatives.
bear: EBITDA margin fell to 18.9% in FY26, missing prior year’s 21.1% level.
PAT declined to 637 cr in FY26 despite higher revenue, indicating margin erosion.
Management’s guidance on FY27 growth and margin remains unfulfilled and many promises lack verification.
questions: What is the target EBITDA margin for FY27 and what actions are being taken to reverse the recent margin decline?
Can you detail the planned FY27 capex as a percentage of revenue and the allocation between tech/AI and other investments?
When will the N‑Dream platform achieve the 3 million vehicle contracts target, and what incremental revenue is expected from it?
